blurb: Guests enjoy rides, scheduled live shows, and attractions like Castaway Island. The park offers group outings with discounted admission and catering options. Rentals include lockers, strollers, wheelchairs, electric convenience vehicles, and wagons.
extraNote: Groups must book and purchase tickets at least two weeks in advance · Payment must be made prior to ticket distribution and park entry · Park operates in most weather conditions; some attractions may close temporarily due to weather · No refunds or rain checks including for inclement weather · Failure to comply with park rules may result in dismissal without refund · Alcoholic beverages may only be purchased and consumed inside the park by those 21+ with valid ID · Smoking only permitted in designated areas · Strollers and wheelchairs rented on a first-come-first-served basis · Operating season dates vary; see 2026 operating calendar
